context:
WITHDRAWN by the coordinator 20:16 CST Nov 14: a ruling answers it; no answer needed.
Goal: a replacement PR keeps the earlier review record when main moves, so nobody re-prints it by hand and the PR does not stall.
Problem (rule): the merge tool's carry (carry_source in merge/merge.py) accepts only a replacement PR whose tree equals the reviewed tree. Accepting "the reviewed head plus a clean merge of main" on a replacement PR lets a record cover a tree its reviewer never read, bounded to main's own commits. That widens a check's verdict. Your rulings 846 a and 847 a cover a clean merge of main on the SAME PR only, and a ruling covers the act it names, never a variant, so only you can say whether it extends to a replacement PR.
Based on (ruling): own-846-a-clean-merge-main-no-verifier (18:30 CST Nov 14) covers line 18's sentence only; own-835-b-into-a (14:56 CST Nov 14, the consultant's relay of your "835 approved b into a") carries a record to a replacement PR whose tree is byte-identical, one source PR. No ruling covers a replacement PR with a clean merge of main (roadmap records, read by triage).
Based on (read): the lane's read of merge/merge.py at main 90feff981bfc, unverified by triage: live_review_state and clean_merges_after forgive a clean merge of main on the same PR by walking its commits; a replacement PR has no such chain.
Based on (read): the one case so far is #3429 (record at b0b2f3bbed) to #3435 (head ffc085233a9e), where lane g1 re-printed the record by hand (comment 6887765565): one stall, n=1 (the coordinator's read, unverified by triage).
Departs from: main (the carry accepts equal trees only) — option a adds one more accepted form: the equal tree plus a clean merge of main.
Meanwhile: lane review-carries-by-tree (session_013NEJKzVWixDqQgAjMzTCgV) listed the eight checks that read a record by head or tree (read-only; its verdict: only the carry, the lint-carried row and `--fix-check` on a replacement share the gap) and builds nothing. The lane lint is not forgiven over a clean merge of main even on one PR today, so widening it for replacements would be wider than main; the lane says leave it exact (the coordinator's call, undoable). If you pick a, the lane builds the carry and the `--fix-check` source gate only. The coordinator recommends b (named at 20:15 CST).

options.gain: No hand re-print of the record after main moves.
options.label: Add the form: equal tree plus a clean merge of main, exact tree only, an unreadable merge-tree reads unknown
options.lose: The carry trusts main's changes that nobody reviewed on this PR. Goes against your ruling: a repo changes to fit a shared tool, never the tool to fit a repo.

options.gain: The check stays as narrow as today.
options.label: Leave the carry equal-tree only; the lane re-prints the record by hand on the replacement
options.lose: One hand re-print per replacement PR when main has moved (1 case so far, n=1).

short: Should a replacement PR keep the review record over a clean merge of main?
title: The merge tool carries a review record to a replacement PR only when the tree is identical. Also carry it over a clean merge of main (a), or keep identical-tree only (b)?
why: Only you can widen a check's verdict beyond the act your rulings name.
